REGULATION OF VOLATILE AIRFARES AND IMPLEMENTATION OF 
RULES UNDER BHARATIYA VAYUYAN ADHINIYAM, 2024
details:
(a): The Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024 (BVA,24) came into effect on 01.01.2025. Nine rules 
are to be re-framed under BVA, 2024. Out of nine rules, four rules have been notified in the Official 
Gazette of India and the remaining rules are under various stages of formulation and deliberations.

details:

records.title: Doppler Weather Radar systems in Himachal Pradesh
details: Three X-Band Doppler Weather Radars (DWRs) have been installed and commissioned at Kufri (Shimla), Murari Devi (Mandi), and Jot (Chamba) in the State of Himachal Pradesh. One more X-Band DWR will be installed in the Lahaul & Spiti District, Himachal Pradesh by December 2025.
